thread:
omar: Quick heads-up 1 just turned in my resignation. Last day will be 2026-10-15 (4 weeks). Posting here so we can track: benefits cutoff, COBRA, badge, laptop, exit interview, and the final contractor invoice process.

tara (People Ops): Thanks @omar. We'll follow the standard offboard but note two items: since your last month was split (W-2 then 1099), Finance needs a clear invoice vs payroll decision. Also benefits: our policy ends active coverage at month-end after last day unless you select a different date.

omar: Understood. Im planning to stay through 10/15 and will file an invoice for Sept/Oct contractor time if needed.

morgan (IT): Hardware 1 do you want IT to arrange a pickup from your address or will you be able to drop at SF HQ? We can also issue a temporary building pass for any drop-off after badge deactivation. Note: API keys + personal OAuth tokens get revoked automatically at 18:00 PT on your last day. If you need temporary access to finish the invoice we can issue a 72h limited vendor token.

sunny (Finance): For invoicing: if you want vendor payment for the partial month, submit an invoice to the vendor portal by 2026-10-22. If you'd prefer payroll (final paycheck), tell us by 2026-10-01 EOD so we can run taxes accordingly. Expenses must be in by 2026-10-18 12:00 PT for inclusion in final settlement.

omar: I'll go vendor route and upload invoice by 10/20. For laptop: drop at HQ on 10/16 morning works. Please send a one-time pass.

morgan (IT): Got it. Pickup canceled. Please back up any personal files and then leave the device unencrypted for inventory. We'll image and reprovision after return. For repo ownership: paste a list of repos/service accounts you maintain or run `gh api orgs/redwood/repos --paginate --jq '.[] | {name,ssh_url}'` and drop it here. We'll queue transfer requests.

tara (People Ops): Exit interview preferences? We can do 20-30 min recorded video or an async form if youd rather. Slots on 10/13 or 10/14 afternoon.

omar: Happy with video on 10/14 at 2pm.

devops-bot: [Automated offboard created] Tasks queued:
- Create deprovision ticket (owner: morgan)
- Create badge deactivation (scheduled: 2026-10-15 17:30 PT)
- Send COBRA packet (scheduled: 2026-10-16)
- Schedule exit interview (owner: tara)
- Finance: vendor invoice follow-up (owner: sunny)

sunny (Finance): Quick Q 1 did you have any relocation/bonus pay prorations this year? If yes, add that to the invoice notes.

omar: No relocation, bonus already paid out earlier in the year.

morgan (IT): Access note: we'll transfer ownership on dashboards and monitoring. Omar, please add @sre-team and @tara as owners for any alerting runbooks. If you can't do it before EOD 10/14, tell me and we'll take care of reassignments.

omar: I'll add owners tonight. Also adding HANDOFF.md to repos with links to runbooks.

tara (People Ops): Final checklist for @omar: 1) Confirm invoice upload by 10/20, 2) RSVP exit interview 10/14 2pm, 3) Drop laptop 10/16 AM at SF HQ (one-time pass sent), 4) Transfer repo/SA ownership or flag repos in thread, 5) Submit expenses by 10/18 12pm PT. After last day we send COBRA notice and confirm deprovision done.

omar: Thanks yall 1 appreciate the help. :pray:
